findings.body: mcp_health_probe.py's repo-aware remediation (MUST_FIX P2) is correctly implemented, but tests/test_mcp_health_probe.py never calls _format_health with a truthy project_root, so a future refactor could silently drop the --repo argument without breaking CI.
